# Reviews

`REVIEW_LOG.md` logs every review and gate check, and `reports/` holds the review reports, referee reports, devil's-advocate checks and the citation-audit write-ups they point at. Nobody reviews their own work, and a FAIL or "reject" blocks its gate until it is resolved and re-reviewed. The Academic Reviewer, the Scientific Peer Reviewer and the Citation & Reference Auditor write the reports and log them; the Research Project Manager checks that every gate decision has its log row.
